name: Helm Chart Releaser
description: Host a Helm charts repo on GitHub Pages

version.description: The chart-releaser version to use (default: v1.7.0)

config.description: The relative path to the chart-releaser config file

install_dir.description: Where to install the cr tool

skip_packaging.description: Skip the packaging option (do your custom packaging before running this action)

skip_existing.description: Skip package upload if release exists

mark_as_latest.description: Mark the created GitHub release as 'latest'

packages_with_index.description: Upload chart packages directly into publishing branch

pages_branch.description: Name of the branch to be used to push the index and artifacts. (default to: gh-pages but it is not set in the action it is a default value for the chart-release
